name: state
meaning: CrocodileLevel11State (Update table 0x435318, SetState table 0x435ba1). Read by SetState before being written, and uninitialised at the first SetState(0) from Init.

name: relocatePhase
meaning: CrocodileLevel11RelocatePhase in state 5: 0 turn toward the new box, 1 walk, 2 turn back toward Daffy.

name: homePos
meaning: Position after Init moved the croc to the x/z centre of homeBox. Restored by Reset unless dead.

name: homeFacing
meaning: rot.y (+0x16) at Init. Restored by every Reset.

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: Wolf MSG_FREEZE reply at SetState(5); cleared by msg 0xe and Reset; set to !(MSG_UNFREEZE reply) at the end of a relocation. Write-only.

name: homeBox
meaning: BOXES entry chosen at Init (containing, or the nearest centre). Reset copies it to curBox.

name: curBox
meaning: Box the croc currently guards. Scanned with ObjGrid_QueryBoxPoints (3-D, origins only); its x/z range decides whether the Wolf or ball has left; the relocation target.

name: boxObjects
meaning: Output of ObjGrid_QueryBoxPoints (cap 64) for curBox (state 0) or bounceBox (state 6).

name: boxObjectCount
meaning: Count returned by the last query. More than 1 in state 0 triggers the scan, since the croc counts itself.

name: prevBoxObjectCount
meaning: Count at the last state-2 scan or dead-state query. A rise in state 6 triggers a bouncer search. Not set by Init.

name: targetIndex
meaning: Index in boxObjects of the Wolf (->state 3) or CannonBall (->state 4) found by the state-2 scan. The last match wins.

name: ball
meaning: CannonBall being watched in state 4; set by SetState(4), which sends it msg 0x3387 arg 0.

name: bounceBox
meaning: NULL from Init. SetState(4) points it at biteBox. Queried by the dead state with no NULL check.

name: biteBox
meaning: Model box 0 with each coord (s16)(c*200)/80 + pos (x2.5 about the croc, axis-aligned). Rebuilt by SetState(3) and (4). The bite zone in state 3 and the trampoline zone in state 6.

name: cineBox
meaning: Scn_GetPropBox(CINEBOX), passed to Cine_Start.

name: cineSheepBox
meaning: Scn_GetPropBox(CINESHEEPBOX), passed to Cine_Start (0 in Lvl-13).

name: activationBox
meaning: Scn_GetPropBox(ACTIVATIONBOX). The Wolf's origin inside it (3-D) starts the one-time cinematic.

name: cineId
meaning: PROPERTY_CROCODILELEVEL11_CINE, Cine_Start id.

name: cineFlags
meaning: PROPERTY_CROCODILELEVEL11_CINEFLAG, Cine_Start flags (418 in Lvl-13).

name: cinePlayed
meaning: Set to 1 when the activation cinematic ends (state 1). Never cleared after Init, so the cine plays once per level load.

name: cineTextIndex
meaning: Low byte of PROPERTY_CROCODILELEVEL11_CINETEXT. Text_GetClassString index passed to Cine_Start as the dialogue text.

name: nextIdleAnimTime
meaning: g_gameTime at which state 0 picks a new idle anim (4/5/6). Re-armed to now by SetState(0) and Reset; after a pick it is set to now + Rand_Bounded(0x5000).

name: bouncer
meaning: Wolf that entered bounceBox on the previous dead-state frame, pending the bounce test.

name: bounceEntryVert
meaning: Bouncer's y when recorded. 0x8000 = none.

name: turnAnim
meaning: Relocation turn anim: 10 or 11, chosen by the turn direction at SetState(5), toggled for the final turn.

name: turnOffset
meaning: Accumulated relocation turn, stepped by (angle difference)/10 per frame.

name: zones
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: Scn_FindIdList(BOXES) list. | count (+4): Count written by Scn_FindIdList. Rand_Bounded bound for the relocation.

name: remainDeadAtReset
meaning: PROPERTY_CROCODILELEVEL11_REMAINDEADATRESET. If non-zero, Reset does not call SetState(0), even for a live croc (1 in Lvl-13).

name: daffy
meaning: Scn_GetPropObject(DAFFY); DaffyLevel01 res 64 in Lvl-13. Only used as the rest heading at the start and end of a relocation.

name: camera
meaning: Scn_GetPropCamera(CAMERA) resource, a CamSetup. Only its eye position at +8 is used (UpdateCamera).
